verdict.rationale: Fivetran is a managed SaaS that handles customer data and ships AI features, so a no-training or AI-training opt-out policy is a fair question to ask. The evidence pack contains no statement about whether customer data is used for model training, and no opt-out control. Data blocking, column hashing and row filtering are adjacent data-minimization controls for syncs, not a training-use guarantee, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
